_comment: forest_bars: Map 3's start/finish gate, the forest's answer to rock_bars. A fallen-log sill across the ground, two thick living end posts grown out of it, a lintel log across their tops, 19 branch bars socketed into the sill's top quads and the lintel's underside quads and bowed gently, two lashing rails welded into the posts at mid height, three leaf sprays where the frame is living wood. 10.6 x 8.5 m filling the lane's cross-section, 0.8 m thick; no opening wider than 0.286 m anywhere, at any height, in any direction (limit 0.38). Origin at the base centre, y=0 is the ground; the gate spans local X, thickness along local Z. One textured material (the forest 256x256 atlas + emissive), one UV set, one contiguous mesh, no skin, no animation. ForestBarsCollision is the sill, the lintel, the two posts, one box per bar spanning that bar's widest reach and one per rail, shipped as a `-colonly` node; Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` stays 1 and `max_tris` counts only what is drawn.
